summary: msi gp66 leopard 10ug-425 system state baseline
suggested_solution: Upgrade RAM: DDR4 SODIMM 3200MHz from Samsung or Crucial.
Upgrade Storage: NVMe SSD with a model like SN770 or SN850.

Thermal Paste Replacement: Clean existing thermal paste before applying new paste. Use one of the following pastes: Honeywell PTM 7950, Coolermaster MasterGel Maker, Gelid GC Extreme, Thermalright TFX, Thermagic ZF-EX, or SYY 157.
Thermal Putty Replacement: Use one of the following thermal putties: K5 Pro or U6 Pro.
CPU Undervolting and GPU Overclocking: Use software like ThrottleStop for CPU undervolting and Afterburner for GPU overclocking.
